verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents REST and GraphQL APIs for managing products, orders, customers and store settings programmatically and for automating store processes. That means bulk changes across many items can be scripted, but the evidence never describes dedicated bulk or batch endpoints or bulk-edit tooling. One community report of API throttling and dropped connections raises doubt about high-volume API use. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints, documented batch limits, bulk import/export or bulk-edit UI evidence, hands-on corroboration of large-scale bulk operations.
